blocks.text: Vertebrates (reerh ki haddi wale janwar) mein vertebral column aur cranium (khopri) hota hai. Yeh saat classes mein batte hain jo do groups mein rakhi gayi hain. Group Pisces mein teen classes hain, Cyclostomata, Chondrichthyes aur Osteichthyes; yeh machhliyan hain aur in ke limbs (haath paon) nahi hote. Group Tetrapoda mein chaar classes hain, Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves aur Mammalia; in ke chaar limbs hote hain.

blocks.alt: Ek chart. Vertebrates do groups mein batte hain. Pisces (limbs nahi) mein teen classes: Cyclostomata, Chondrichthyes, Osteichthyes. Tetrapoda (chaar limbs) mein chaar classes: Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves, Mammalia.
blocks.caption: Vertebrates ki saat classes apne do groups mein (asal chart).
blocks.long_description: Machhliyan group Pisces banati hain: jabre ke baghair machhliyan, cartilage wali machhliyan aur haddi wali machhliyan. Chaar limbs wali classes group Tetrapoda banati hain: amphibians, reptiles, parinde aur mammals.

blocks.text: Group Pisces
1. Class Cyclostomata

Yeh jabre ke baghair (jawless) machhliyan hain; lampreys aur hagfish aam misaalein hain. Jism baam machhli (eel) jaisa hota hai aur us par scales nahi hote. Skeleton cartilage ka hota hai. Doosri machhliyon ki tarah in ka dil single-circuit hai, jis mein ek atrium aur ek ventricle hota hai. Fertilisation jism ke bahar (external) hoti hai.
2. Class Chondrichthyes

Is class mein sharks, skates, rays aur ratfishes aate hain. Skeleton cartilage ka hota hai. Jism par placoid (daant jaise) scales hote hain jinhein denticles kehte hain. In mein jabre (jaws) aur kaatne wale mouthparts hote hain. Pectoral aur pelvic fins joron mein hote hain, aur do dorsal fins hote hain. Dil single-circuit hai, ek atrium aur ek ventricle ke saath. Aankhon ke peeche chhote soorakhon ka ek jora hota hai jise spiracle kehte hain; yeh saans lene ke kaam aate hain. In mein swim bladder nahi hota. Fertilisation andar (internal) hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Shark pehlu se: do dorsal fins, caudal fin, anal fin, pelvic fin, pectoral fin, sar ke peeche paanch gill slits aur aankh ke peeche spiracle. Neeche gol khaane mein jild ka ek tukra bara kar ke daant jaise denticles dikhaye gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.21: Cartilaginous fishes (kitab ki Figure 1.21 ke mutabiq shark ka asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shark ki jild par placoid scales hote hain jinhein denticles kehte hain; bara kiya hua gol khaana dikhata hai ke yeh chhote daanton jaise hain. Gill slits par koi dhakkan (operculum) nahi hota, is liye bahar se saaf dikhte hain. Spiracle aankh ke peeche ek chhota soorakh hai jo saans mein madad karta hai. Pectoral aur pelvic fins jore (paired) mein hain.
3. Class Osteichthyes

Haddi wali machhliyon (bony fishes) mein haddi ka endoskeleton, streamlined jism, jild (skin) ke haddi wale (dermal bony) scales aur aage ki taraf (terminal) mouth hota hai jis mein jabre hote hain, daanton ke saath ya baghair. Notochord vertebral column se badal jata hai, agarche kuch bony fishes isey sikri hui shakal mein rakhti hain. Swim bladder tairte rehne (buoyancy) mein madad deta hai. In mein median fins (dorsal, caudal aur ventral) aur jore-daar fins (pelvic aur pectoral) dono hote hain. Gills ke chaar jore hote hain, jinhein haddi ka ek dhakkan, operculum, dhaanpta hai. Nervous system achhi tarah bana hota hai, jis mein cranial nerves ke das jore hote hain. Fertilisation zyada tar external hoti hai. Meethe paani ki bony fishes mein rohu, trout, katla aur catfish shamil hain; samandari bony fishes mein seahorse, flying fish aur angler fish.

blocks.alt: Haddi wali machhli (perch jaisi) ki andar ki banawat, pehlu se: dorsal, caudal, pelvic aur anal fins; sar mein eye, nostril aur brain; aadhe kate operculum ke neeche gills; gills ke peeche heart aur liver; peeth ke saath spinal cord, kidney aur swim bladder; pait mein stomach, intestine, gonad, urinary bladder aur anus.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.22: Haddi wali machhliyon ki numainda misaalein aur aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 1.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; sirf aam banawat).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Operculum gills ko dhaanpne wala haddi ka dhakkan hai; khaake mein us ka kuch hissa kaat kar neeche gills dikhaye gaye hain. Neela lamba thaila swim bladder hai jis mein gas bhar kar machhli paani mein upar neeche rehti hai (buoyancy). Shark ke baraks yahan gills bahar se nazar nahi aate. Dorsal, caudal aur anal fins akele (median) hain; pelvic fins jore mein hain.

blocks.text: Group Tetrapoda
4. Class Amphibia

Amphibia tetrapods ki pehli class hai. In mein haddi ka endoskeleton hota hai. Machhliyon ke baraks amphibians ki gardan (neck) hoti hai: pehla (cervical) vertebra khopri ke pichhle hisse ke saath harkat karta hai aur khopri ko upar neeche hilne deta hai. Jild (skin) hamwar, scales ke baghair aur nam hoti hai. Yeh gason ke tabadle, temperature control, aur paani jazb aur zakheera karne mein madad deti hai. Dil double-circuit aur teen chambers wala hai: do atria aur ek ventricle. Larva ke marhale mein yeh gills se aur baalig hone par lungs (phephron) aur jild se saans lete hain.

Amphibians bahar ki garmi (external heat source) par inhisaar karte hain, is liye ectotherms hain. Yeh apne jism ka temperature control ya ek jaisa nahi rakh sakte, is liye poikilothermic hain, aur sardiyon mein hibernate karte hain (lambi neend). Salamanders, newts aur mud puppies dum wale amphibians hain; mendak (frogs) aur toads bina dum ke; aur caecilians bina taangon ke. Amphibians unisexual hain, aur fertilisation aam taur par external hoti hai.
5. Class Reptilia

Reptiles pehla janwaron ka group hain jin mein amniotic eggs (ande) hote hain. Amniotic egg hifazati extra-embryonic membranes banata hai, amnion, allantois aur chorion, jo embryo ko sookhne se bachati hain, ghiza (food) deti hain aur use zameen par develop hone deti hain. Ande mein bohat sa yolk (zardi) hota hai, jo embryo ki buniyadi ghiza hai, aur kaafi albumin (safedi), jo mazeed ghiza aur paani deti hai. Anda chamre jaise (leathery), calcium wale khol se dhaka hota hai jo gason ke liye kuch had tak guzarne wala (permeable) hai lekin paani ke liye nahi.

blocks.alt: Amniotic egg (anda) kat kar: shell ke andar chorion poore ande ko gherti hai. Mura hua embryo ek fluid bhari thaili, amnion, mein hai. Bari peeli yolk sac aur hari allantois dono dandiyon se embryo se juri hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.24: Amniotic egg (kitab ki Figure 1.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Amnion embryo ke gird ek jhilli (membrane) hai; us ke andar ka fluid embryo ko sookhne aur jhatkon se bachata hai. Yolk sac (peeli) mein ghiza hai. Allantois (hari) fuzla jama karti hai aur chorion ke saath mil kar gas exchange mein madad karti hai. Chorion sab se bahar wali jhilli hai jo shell ke andar poore ande ko gherti hai. Shell se gases guzar sakti hain lekin paani nahi.

Reptiles ki jild khushk aur scales wali hoti hai. Haddi ka endoskeleton amphibians se zyada sakht hota hai, aur khopri lambi hoti hai. Pehle do cervical vertebrae, atlas aur axis, sar ko zyada harkat dete hain. Dil mein ventricle adhoora taur par baayein aur daayein ventricles mein batta hai. Amphibians ki tarah reptiles ectothermic hain aur temperature ke liye bahar ki garmi istemaal karte hain; yeh jism ka temperature ek jaisa nahi rakh sakte aur poikilotherms hain. Fertilisation internal hai, aur yeh oviparous hain, yani ande dete hain. Aaj ke reptiles chhipkaliyan (lizards), saanp (snakes), tuatara aur magarmachh (crocodiles) hain.
6. Class Aves

Parindon (birds) ke jism par pankhon (feathers) ka ghilaaf hota hai. Feathers urne ki satah banate hain jo lift deti hai aur rukh badalne mein madad karti hai, aur yeh garmi aur paani ke zayan ko bhi rokte hain. Parinde endotherms hain: yeh apne cells ke amal se garmi hasil karte hain, aur andar ka yeh garmi ka zariya unhein jism ka darja (level) hararat taqreeban ek jaisa rakhne deta hai. Jo janwar apna core temperature ek jaisa rakhte hain unhein homeotherms kehte hain.

Jism streamlined aur takli (spindle) jaisa hota hai. Agle limbs par (wings) ban gaye hain. Haddiyan bari hawa ki jagahon ki wajah se halki hoti hain. Daanton ki jagah ek halka ghilaaf, chonch (bill), hoti hai. Seene ki haddi (sternum) par ek bari haddi, keel, hoti hai jis se urne ke muscles jure hote hain. Chonchein aur zubaanein khane ke mukhtalif tareeqon aur ghiza ke mutabiq (according to) badli hui hoti hain.

Bohat se parindon mein oesophagus ki ek thaili, crop, ghiza jama karti hai take parinda jaldi se bohat si ghiza le sake. Stomach ka ek hissa, gizzard, muscular deewaron se ghiza ko peesta hai. Dil chaar chambers ka hai, jis mein atria aur ventricles poori tarah alag hain. Nervous system bohat achha bana hota hai, aur zyada tar parindon ke liye nazar (vision) aur sunna (hearing) sab se aham hawaas hain. Bahar ke nathne (external nares) naak ke raston se pharynx mein khulte hain; pharynx se trachea aur phir bronchi tak rasta jata hai. Awaaz ka organ, syrinx, trachea ke nichle sire par hota hai. Bronchi hawa ki thailiyon (air sacs) ke ek complex nizam (system) mein khulti hain jo jism ke bare hisse mein phaili hoti hain aur kuch haddiyon tak bhi jaati hain. Air sacs lungs se juri hoti hain, jo chhoti hawa ki naliyon, parabronchi, se bane hote hain.

Reptiles aur mammals ki tarah parindon ke ande amniotic hote hain, bohat se yolk aur albumin ke saath, aur chamre jaise khol se dhake hote hain. Fertilisation internal aur development bahar hoti hai: parinde oviparous hain. Kuch parindon ne baad mein urne ki taqat kho di aur daurne wale parinde kehlate hain, jaise shuturmurgh (ostrich), kiwi, rhea, cassowary aur emu. Urne wale parindon mein kabootar (pigeon), tota (parrot), kawwa (crow), uqaab (eagle) aur robin shamil hain.
7. Class Mammalia

Mammals woh vertebrates hain jo maa ke mammary glands ke doodh se parwarish paate hain aur jin ke jism par baal (hair) hote hain. Mammals ki jild mein epidermis se bane ghadood (glands) hote hain: sebaceous (tail ke) glands tail jaisa maadda banate hain, aur sudoriferous (paseene ke) glands paani jaisa maadda nikalte hain jo bhaap ban kar thanda karta hai (evaporative cooling). Mammary glands maada mammals mein kaam karte hain. Zyada tar mammals ki zindagi mein daanton ke do sets hote hain, doodh ke daant aur mustaqil daant. Bahar ka kaan, pinna, maujood hota hai, aur darmiyani kaan mein teen haddiyon ki zanjeer hoti hai: incus, malleus aur stapes.

Mammals endothermic aur homeothermic hain. In ka dil chaar chambers ka hai, aur ek muscular diaphragm coelom ko seene (thoracic) aur pait (abdominal) ki cavities mein baant deta hai. Awaaz ka nizam achhi tarah bana hai: larynx jis mein vocal cords hain, aur epiglottis. Fertilisation internal hai. Zyada tar mammals, placental mammals, bachon ko janam dete hain aur viviparous hain; kuch ande dete hain aur oviparous hain; aur marsupials in ke darmiyan hain. Teen groups hain.

items: Anda dene wale mammals aise ande dete hain jin mein embryo ki poori development hoti hai. Yeh Australia mein milte hain: duckbill platypus aur echidna (spiny anteater).

Marsupials ki maada ke pait par ek thaili, marsupium, hoti hai. Yeh na-mukammal (immature) bachon ko janam dete hain jo maa ki thaili mein apni development poori karte hain; textbook inhein ovoviviparous kehti hai. Misaalein: opossum, kangaroo aur Tasmanian wolf.

Placental mammals sab se taraqqi yafta mammals hain. Development ke dauran maa ke uterus ki deewar aur foetus ke jism ke darmiyan ek banawat, placenta, banti hai. Foetus ko ghiza isi placenta se milti hai aur us ka fuzla isi se nikalta hai. Misaalein: dolphin, chooha (rat), bandar (monkey), chamgadar (bat), haathi (elephant) aur insaan.

blocks.text: Mukhtasir khulasa

items: Vertebrates mein vertebral column aur cranium hota hai; saat classes do groups mein: Pisces (limbs nahi) aur Tetrapoda (chaar limbs).

Cyclostomata: jawless, scales nahi, cartilage. Chondrichthyes: cartilage, placoid scales, spiracle, swim bladder nahi, internal fertilisation. Osteichthyes: haddi, operculum, swim bladder, gills ke chaar jore.
Amphibia: nam jild, teen chambers ka dil, pehle gills phir lungs aur jild, ectothermic, hibernate.
Reptilia: pehla amniotic egg (amnion, allantois, chorion, yolk, albumin, leathery khol), khushk scales wali jild, atlas aur axis, adhoora bata ventricle, oviparous.
Aves: feathers, endothermic aur homeothermic, wings, halki haddiyan, chonch, keel, crop aur gizzard, chaar chambers ka dil, syrinx, air sacs aur parabronchi, oviparous.
Mammalia: doodh aur baal, jild ke glands, daanton ke do sets, pinna aur kaan ki teen haddiyan, chaar chambers ka dil, diaphragm, larynx; anda dene wale, marsupial aur placental groups.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si classes ka dil chaar chambers ka hai, aur kaun si class sab se pehle amniotic ande dene wali thi?
blocks.explanation: Aves aur Mammalia ka dil chaar chambers ka hai jis mein atria aur ventricles poori tarah alag hain. Reptilia pehla group tha jis mein amniotic eggs thay.
